verdict.rationale: ReelMimic defines characters, assets and style frames in an approved plan before production. Its Production line tab tracks each character across the video's parts, and it follows user-supplied character designs. Together this implies shared character and asset definitions reused across shots, but no source explicitly claims or demonstrates cross-shot consistency. missing for 10: an explicit claim that characters and scenes stay consistent across shots, a description of how consistency is enforced or checked in review, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
